title: IEBA — Industrial Engineering Platform
description: Workforce and cost-analytics platform used by industrial engineering teams for payroll, time study, FTE allocation, and leave workflows.
bullets: Shipped feature modules for payroll, personal time study, cost-pool, department, and FTE allocation.
Built role-based leave approval, program, reports, and notification flows on NestJS + MySQL.
Integrated MinIO object storage and Redis caching for document-heavy industrial workflows.

title: CSA — Certificate & Allotment Portal
description: Government-facing allotment portal with Indian i18n, SMS OTP, and digital-certificate generation for civic applicants.
bullets: Implemented admin, CA-sites, auth, roles, and allotment modules used by real applicants.
Added react-i18next locale packs and SMS-backed OTP for multilingual government users.
Wired digital-certificate generation and Axios caching on the NestJS API.

title: Layout Master — GIS Auction Platform
description: Geographic layout and auction-eligibility system with Leaflet maps, site master data, and object storage.
bullets: Built layout, sites, auction-eligibility, and master-geographic modules.
Mapped parcels on Leaflet 1.9 and enforced role-based access to auction data.

title: Keonics — Procurement & Facilities
description: Enterprise operations suite covering approval flow, procurement, HR, and facilities with maps and calendar.
bullets: Worked on approval-flow, procurement, HR, and facilities modules.
Integrated Google Maps, react-big-calendar, and a rich-text editor on the Crema template.

title: Timesheet — Employee Time Tracking
description: Timesheet product with employee, manager, and admin dashboards, JWT cookie refresh, and mail alerts.
bullets: Built EmployeeDashboard, ManagerMapping, AdminDashboard, and EmpTimesheet views.
Used redux-persist plus JWT cookie refresh and mailer on the NestJS backend.

title: CDRMS — Camera & Device Mobile App
description: Expo React Native field app for camera, device, media, and project capture against a NestJS 11 API.
bullets: Contributed to camera, device, media, project, and screen modules on mobile.
Connected notifications and navigation to a throttled, cached NestJS API.
